newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian guard jailed in banker's prison break.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian guard jailed in banker's prison break.

text.p: A Jakarta prison guard has been jailed for eight months for his involvement in the escape of renegade businessman Eddy Tansil last May, the Jakarta Post newspaper reported on Thursday.

It said the East Jakarta District Court on Wednesday had found Maryono, a 47-year-old guard at the city's Cipinang prison, guilty of helping Tansil escape and of receiving bribes of 100,000 rupiah ($42).
Tansil walked out of Cipinang prison ostensibly for a medical check-up and disappeared. He is believed to have fled the country.
He was serving a 20-year sentence for defrauding state- owned Bank Pembangunan Indonesia (Bapindo) of $430 million in Indonesia's biggest banking scandal.
Maryono is one of five guards charged with involvement in Tansil's escape. One guard has already been sentenced to eight months in jail and three others are currently on trial.
